ends.note: paper street (printed 'SECTION (NOT OPEN)', 30 ft) ends at the south line of the Dorchester block; its west line stops already at ~y 1477 at a lot corner

notes: Mt Auburn between Highland Avenue (west) and Reading Road (east), Dorchester Avenue along the top. Dorchester (printed 'DORCHESTER AV.', 50 ft) has Burnet Avenue ('BURNET AV.', 4 in. pipe) and Ryan Avenue ('RYAN AV.', 6 in. pipe) ending at its north side; centre taken along the 10/12 in. pipe in Dorchester, which matches the mid-line of the block lines. Dorchester crosses Reading Road at the top-right corner and continues east as Florence Avenue (named so on sheet 167; the Florence name is not printed here). Reading Road's east line is beyond the paper edge in the upper half; its centre was taken ~120 px (half of 70 ft) east of the west line and checked against the 20 in. water pipe. Highland ('HIGHLAND AV.', 50 ft) has Carmalt, Channing and Ringgold (sheet 165 outlines, names printed) ending at its west side; Highland's lots on the east side are continuous, so these are T's. At ~y 1448 Highland turns NW onto a 50 ft diagonal that runs out of the left edge; its centreline meets the Dorchester centreline only off the sheet (~x 60), so no point is given. Section Street is a paper street (printed 'SECTION (NOT OPEN)', 30 ft) running from its north end (see ends) straight to the bottom edge; it meets no street on this sheet. The dash-dot line A-B at y~4290 marked '159' is the sheet-159 join line, not a street. Highland at Ringgold sits just above the join line.
